name: Distraction
overview: Scripture reveals that distraction can hinder our relationship with God and our spiritual calling, as seen when God declares He will turn away from prayers if hearts are divided or insincere. Believers are urged to maintain focused attention, keeping their eyes fixed straight ahead, and to be still in God's presence, acknowledging His sovereignty. The example of Jesus being led by the Spirit into the wilderness highlights the reality of spiritual testing and the need to resist distractions from the enemy. The story of Martha receiving Jesus also reminds us to prioritize spiritual attentiveness over worldly concerns.
